desc:
Become a cat and steal fish from markets!

How to Play!
🧊 Steal frozen fish from the market
☀️Melt the ice to collect rare fish
💵Earn money from fish in your aquarium
🐱Compete with each other for World Class Exotic fish
🏃Become faster on treadmills to outrun angry market owners

Be careful of the market owners, they become giants when angry!
